summary: Selects the string to copy: when the global guard dword_7D0398 is nonzero and dword_7D0410 is not 5, the incoming string pointer a1 is replaced with the global default path byte_5EA438; otherwise a1 is kept. The selected string is then passed to StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and its result is returned. Called from the frontend loading display handler and sub_4A0AF0.

operations.description: Guard: if dword_7D0398 is nonzero and dword_7D0410 is not equal to 5, replace the incoming string pointer a1 with the global default string byte_5EA438.
Call StringCopyWithBufferRealloc on the selected string pointer (a1 or the substituted default) to produce the copied string.
Return the copied-string result produced by StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.
